title: Well-posedness and Stability of Thermoelastic Suspension Bridges with Cattaneo Heat Conduction: The Role of Viscoelastic Memory
summary: Thermoelastic suspension bridges operate under strong thermo-mechanical coupling, and the classical Fourier law fails to capture the finite speed of thermal propagation observed in low-conductivity materials such as concrete. This paper investigates a suspension bridge model in which the heat flux is governed by the Cattaneo law with relaxation time $τ$, and in which the bridge deck may or may not possess viscoelastic memory.
